item.tib: g.yung drung bon gyi sgra bsgrags pa rin po che'i gling grags
item.coloph: g.yung drung bon gyi sgra bsgrag (bsgrags) zhes bya ba/ bon dar nub byung tshul gleng gzhi'i tshul du gsung (gsungs) pa bkod de/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha' dang / gcod (co) za bon mo la sogs/ rgyud sde dang lung don man ngag sgra tshad la sogs/ bon sgo tha dag mkhyen pa/ grub pa bsnyem cing (zhing) 'gro don nus pa/ tshe'i rig 'dzin shes bya thams cad sa le mkhyen pa/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa'i gyer spungs chen po rnams kyis phyi rabs gshen po rnams kyi the tshom sel cing yid ches bskyed pa'i phyir/ bka' rgyas btab nas gter du sbas/ las can gcig dang 'phrad par shog ces smon lam btab nas sbas so/ byang gter gsang ba'i bon skor yin/ g.yung drung bon gyi sgra bsgrags sgrag (bsgrags) pa rin po che'i gling grags 'di ni//
